name: Arabella Frost (Assembly)
appearance: Dark hair pinned up with loose curls, pale and watchful; ivory empire gown under a short dark-green spencer, long white gloves.
definition: Testbed variant of the player heroine, drawn from the Assembly playthrough package. Not the player character — a cast sprite for the-assembly episode only.
voice: Dry, quick, never leaves a cleverness unanswered.
